results.evidence: 22 of 22 deterministic state, lease, retry, callback, duplicate, path, and active-job controls passed.
Eight Python tests and 18 worker/deployment contracts passed.
13 of 13 durable upload failure and recovery scenarios passed.
Twenty synthetic 600-page packets completed across ten workers with bounded retries, zero duplicate claims, zero dead letters, and verified resume.
The schema-v2 synthetic harness passed eight labeled fields; its 0.6756 lower bound is not a production accuracy claim.
The exact-start complexity ratchet passed with the inherited reviewed dispositions.

observedFindings: Provider attachment and reconciliation updates were not fenced by attempt token after their external waits, so a reclaimed attempt could receive stale provider state.
Heartbeat checked the attempt before its update but did not verify the update affected a row, allowing a concurrent lease transition to be reported as a successful heartbeat.
The worker and database retained page-level evidence images but did not carry Document Intelligence bounding polygons through the durable field and candidate contracts.
